If revoke fails, the OLD refresh token remains valid alongside the new one — two concurrently valid refresh tokens defeat rotation-based replay detection.
Fix: make revoke+issue atomic in one tx, or fail refresh (500) when revoke fails. (Security property rotation is supposed to provide.)
